verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a security scanning tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only a flag-driven CLI (e.g. `--include-detectors`, `--only-verified`), config files and a web UI. Nothing documents an assistant or any way to drive scans in natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
